title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) CRIME IN INDIA - 1995 9.6.2 The crime rate was very high in Pondicherry (2.6), Karnataka (0.7), Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu (0.4%) in 1995. Incidence-wise, during this period, Karnataka (342) reported the highest number followed by Maharashtra (359), Andhra Pradesh (265), Tamil Nadu (211) and Uttar Pradesh (121). The above 5 States together contributed around 84.9 per cent of the total cases reported at All-India.
